entries.title: Gold Dinar of al-Muktafi
entries.sourceNote: The original Abbasid gold dinar is21mm in diameter, according to Finland’s official museum catalogue.
entries.geometryReview: The entire coin is the connected Object_4 mesh, visually green in the component render; the centimeter bar is the distinct orange Object_38. Apply the original 21 mm diameter to the coin vertical diameter only. Its horizontal diameter then becomes 20.75 mm, corroborating an irregular circular edge. The ruler is retained but excluded from the scale reference.

entries.title: Tombstone of Fatima Ibnat Yaqub
entries.sourceNote: Published physical dimensions. The scan and measurement scope have been reviewed for scale.
entries.geometryReview: Complete front face of Fatima’s tombstone with two small upper clips. The unscanned reverse remains an existing geometry limitation.
